summary: The geocoding lookup from v4 with at most three attempts, backoff, no retry on a 4xx, a timeout, an API key and a per-key rate limit.

must_not_flag.reason: A fixed maximum of three attempts with exponential backoff and a 5-second timeout each; a 4xx other than 429 stops at once. The route needs an API key and is limited per key before any geocoder call, so one request makes at most three metered calls.
